# Xtreme AI

> Xtreme AI is an AI-powered growth operating system for local businesses. We combine AI services, AI consulting, website creation, SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and full-stack marketing into one approval-gated system that generates real, qualified leads. Based in Pompano Beach, FL, serving South Florida and clients nationwide.

## Core Services

- [AI Services](https://leadgenerationnearyou.com/): AI chatbots, lead qualification, content automation, and custom AI tools that capture, qualify, and convert leads 24/7.
- [AI Consulting](https://leadgenerationnearyou.com/): AI strategy, implementation, team training, and system integration for businesses adopting AI.
- [Website Creation](https://leadgenerationnearyou.com/): Conversion-focused websites, landing pages, sales funnels, and web apps built to turn visitors into leads.
- [SEO (Search Engine Optimization)](https://leadgenerationnearyou.com/): Local SEO, technical SEO, content SEO, and Google Business Profile optimization to rank on page 1 of Google.
- [AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)](https://leadgenerationnearyou.com/): Optimization for AI search engines — get cited by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and voice assistants.
- [Full-Stack Marketing](https://leadgenerationnearyou.com/): Paid media, social, email, SMS, branding, and content marketing engineered to deliver real leads.

## Pricing

- [Pricing Plans](https://leadgenerationnearyou.com/pricing): Free Starter ($0), Pro ($499/mo), Elite ($1,499/mo), Enterprise (custom). Individual AI tools start at $99, web packs at $2,500, app packs at $5,000.
